_comment: PERF-ROG / OP23-01. Every per-frame performance lever the Meadows chapter has, in one place, so an owner playing on the ROG Ally can turn one without a rebuild. Read by scripts/world/performance_config.gd. ALL TUNABLE. Measured baselines for each are in ralph/PERF_ROG_REPORT.md; re-measure with tools/perf_profile.gd after changing anything here.
_comment_interaction: interaction_grid_cell_m: edge of the uniform x/z grid interaction_arbiter.gd files prompt providers into, metres. The arbiter used to poll all 24,461 registered providers every frame (15.6ms/frame measured on this corridor) to find the two within reach; it now walks only the cells around the player. Cell size trades cells-walked against providers-per-cell and wants to be in the same order as the largest prompt radius (4.0m today). Correctness does not depend on it.
_comment_collision_streaming: vegetation.gd streams real CollisionShape3D nodes in around the player for the scattered trees, rocks and saplings. collision_stream_radius_m is the bubble; collision_stream_interval_s is how often playground_world.gd re-centres it; collision_stream_cell_m is the grid the sweep walks instead of every solid placement in the world. Measured before the grid: 9.2ms per sweep over 22,306 solid placements, twice a second -- a judder rather than a frame-rate floor, but a judder the player feels twice a second.
_comment_scatter_lod: scatter_lod_ranges applies each vegetation layer's lod_range/lod_fade_margin (data/config/vegetation.json) to its Terrain3DMeshAsset, which Terrain3D turns into a real RenderingServer.instance_geometry_set_visibility_range on the MultiMeshes that layer draws. DEFAULT FALSE, which is exactly what shipped before PERF-ROG: measured with tools/perf_render_stats.gd on four elevated views, the AUTHORED ranges (110-260m) change draw calls by less than measurement noise, and FORCING every range to 20m -- culling everything past twenty metres, which no player would accept -- removes only 5-16%. The lever works; it is just not where the frames are. Left wired and gated rather than commented out so the next lane measures instead of re-deriving. Numbers in ralph/PERF_ROG_REPORT.md.
_comment_overlay: debug_overlay_on_boot turns the F3 performance readout on from the first frame, for a device the owner cannot press F3 on: the ROG Ally is a handheld, and the owner's authored controller map (2026-08-22) spends every pad button on a gameplay verb with held chords banned, so there is no spare press to give this and a config flag is the honest answer rather than a colliding binding. Flip it, build, play, photograph the readout. debug_overlay_level: 1 = frame time, draw calls and the top three measured costs (scripts/world/perf_trace.gd); 2 = that plus movement and input diagnostics. F3 still cycles it on a keyboard.
